Buffini Social Suite (Referral Maker Social Suite) is a template-based social media automation tool for real estate agents. It provides pre-written content, a Design Studio with customizable templates, and automated scheduling to 6 platforms. There is no custom local content creation, no video editing, and every agent in the Buffini network pulls from the same template library.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Is Buffini Social Suite a done-for-you service?
No. Buffini Social Suite is a template-based automation tool.
Can I buy Buffini Social Suite without a coaching membership?
No. Buffini Social Suite is not available as a standalone product.
Does Buffini Social Suite include video editing?
No. Buffini Social Suite can auto-generate listing videos from MLS data, but it does not offer custom video editing services. You cannot upload raw footage and get a polished video back.
